name: Bagbazar Sarbojanin
highlight: One of the oldest sarbojanin pujas. Traditional daker saaj idol, plus a riverside fair.

name: Kumartuli Park Sarbojanin
highlight: Next door to the idol-makers' quarter. Expect bold, artistic themes every year.

name: Kumartuli Sarbojanin
highlight: Worshipped where the idols are born. Walk the artisan lanes on the way.

name: Ahiritola Sarbojanin
highlight: A riverside neighbourhood puja known for large-scale theme work.

name: Ahiritola Jubak Brinda
highlight: A short hop from Ahiritola Sarbojanin, with inventive craft themes.

name: Sovabazar Rajbari
highlight: A bonedi bari puja started by Raja Nabakrishna Deb. The thakurdalan is stunning.

name: Kashi Bose Lane
highlight: A lane-side puja that keeps winning art awards.

name: Nalin Sarkar Street
highlight: A famous Hatibagan theme puja tucked into a narrow lane.

name: Hatibagan Sarbojanin
highlight: Right at the Hatibagan crossing. Easy to combine with street shopping.

name: Hatibagan Nabin Pally
highlight: A smaller theme puja a few minutes from the Hatibagan crossing.

name: Jagat Mukherjee Park
highlight: Park-based theme puja near Shyambazar.

name: Tala Prattoy
highlight: North Kolkata's blockbuster theme puja. The queue moves fast at dawn.

name: Mohammad Ali Park
highlight: A Central Avenue giant known for lavish replicas and theme pandals.

name: Chaltabagan Lohapatty
highlight: Theme puja off Bidhan Sarani that regularly picks up awards.

name: Simla Byayam Samity
highlight: Historic puja in Swami Vivekananda's neighbourhood.

name: College Square Sarbojanin
highlight: The lighting reflected on the College Square pond is iconic at night.

name: Santosh Mitra Square (Lebutala)
highlight: Known for giant replica pandals (it once built a gold idol and a chariot), so the queues get long.

name: Sealdah Railway Athletic Club
highlight: Right next to Sealdah station. Easy to add to the Santosh Mitra visit.

name: Ekdalia Evergreen
highlight: A huge traditional idol in a temple-replica pandal. A South Kolkata staple.

name: Singhi Park
highlight: Grand traditional puja just off Gariahat Road.

name: Ballygunge Cultural Association
highlight: Thoughtful art-led themes in a calm-ish setting.

name: Hindustan Park Sarbojanin
highlight: An art-college aesthetic, with fewer crowds than its neighbours.

name: Jodhpur Park
highlight: Big theme pandal in a residential para.

name: Babubagan Sarbojanin
highlight: Neighbourhood puja between Dhakuria and Selimpur.

name: Bosepukur Sitala Mandir
highlight: Famous for intricate material-based pandals.

name: Bosepukur Talbagan
highlight: Bosepukur's other award-winning theme puja.

name: Maddox Square
highlight: Kolkata's favourite adda ground. A traditional idol and the city's best people-watching.

name: Samaj Sebi Sangha
highlight: An elegant puja on Lake View Road with a long cultural legacy.

name: Shib Mandir Sarbojanin
highlight: A compact theme puja near Lake Market.

name: Deshapriya Park
highlight: Once famous for the biggest Durga idol in the world, it now runs grand themes.

name: Tridhara Sammilani
highlight: A South Kolkata showstopper with dazzling theme and light work.

name: 66 Pally
highlight: A Kalighat-side theme puja that often has a social message.

name: Mudiali Club
highlight: Thoughtful themes with an eco slant near Tollygunge.

name: Badamtala Ashar Sangha
highlight: A theme favourite, usually built from unusual materials.

name: Chetla Agrani Club
highlight: Celebrity-studded inaugurations and blockbuster themes across Tolly Nullah.

name: Suruchi Sangha
highlight: New Alipore's showpiece, famous for themes that bring in the art of a different Indian state each year.

name: Behala Notun Dal
highlight: Art-led theme pujas with strong craft work.

name: Behala Friends
highlight: A consistent theme puja near Behala Chowrasta.

name: Behala Sahajatri
highlight: A smaller Behala theme puja with fewer queues.

name: Barisha Club
highlight: Behala's southern anchor, known for detailed themes.

name: FD Block Salt Lake
highlight: Salt Lake's biggest crowd puller, with a grand idol and a full-blown mela.

name: BJ Block Salt Lake
highlight: A spacious theme pandal with an easy walk from Central Park.

name: AE Block Salt Lake
highlight: A relaxed block puja that's good for families.

name: Sreebhumi Sporting Club
highlight: Insta-famous replica pandals and huge gold jewellery on the idol. Lake Town gridlocks for hours.

name: Lake Town Adhibasi Brinda
highlight: A short walk from Sreebhumi, and much calmer.

name: Dum Dum Park Bharat Chakra
highlight: Part of the Dum Dum Park theme row, known for art installations.

name: Dum Dum Park Tarun Sangha
highlight: Theme heavyweight on the Dum Dum Park strip.

name: Dum Dum Park Sarbojanin
highlight: The traditional stop on the Dum Dum Park strip.
